title: Covariant Effective Field Theory for Entropy-Driven Gravitational Modification: Derivation, Falsification, and Structural Results from a 17-Iteration Construction Programme
description: Presents a covariant scalar–tensor EFT in which an entropy-like scalar S modifies gravity via an acceleration-dependent response, developed and stress-tested through 17 falsification iterations. The work derives five structural results that hold independent of the specific response function, and identifies a critical gap: the classical action yields a correction that increases with acceleration, opposite to the RAR, motivating an EFT with the empirical µ(g) postulated.

rar_interpolation.description: Empirical Radial Acceleration Relation (RAR) connecting observed acceleration to that predicted from baryons with a single acceleration scale a0.

mu_be.description: Gravitational enhancement is formally identical to a Bose–Einstein occupation number with dimensionless energy x = \sqrt{g/a0}.

efc_action.latex: S = \int d^4x\,\sqrt{-g}\,\Big[ \frac{R}{16\pi G_N} + \tfrac{1}{2} g^{\mu\nu} \partial_\mu S\, \partial_\nu S - V(S) - \beta\, \lvert \partial S \rvert_{\epsilon}\, S^2 + \mathcal{L}_m \Big]
efc_action.description: Minimal covariant action with one scalar S, no non-minimal metric coupling; the modification enters via a gradient–field coupling term.

regularised_gradient.description: Regularized gradient norm providing a vacuum floor regulator for the S-field coupling.

potential.description: Quadratic stabilizing potential; m_S sets a galactic-scale screening length \lambda_S = 1/m_S.

gw_speed.description: For actions of the form R/(16\pi G) + F(g, S, \partial S) with no metric derivatives in F, the tensor kinetic operator is identical to GR, implying exactly luminal GW speed.

slip.description: Gravitational slip is unity up to corrections suppressed by the weak-field potential times the response \mu.

a0_value.description: Empirically measured acceleration scale from SPARC/RAR, used as the single effective parameter in the EFT response.

key_results.main_finding: Five structural results (c_gw=c, \eta\approx1 with O(\Phi\mu) suppression, solar-system amplitude suppression, stability, and RAR\equivBose–Einstein form) hold, but the classical action’s field equation yields the wrong sign versus RAR, necessitating an EFT with postulated \mu(g).

sealed_predictions.statement: Gravitational-wave propagation speed equals c exactly in vacuum across astrophysical frequencies (tensor sector identical to GR).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Multi-messenger time-of-flight constraints from GW–EM coincidences (e.g., future GW170817-like events) or broadband dispersion analyses.

sealed_predictions.statement: Gravitational slip remains near unity in weak-field galactic environments: |eta - 1| = O(Phi*mu) with |eta - 1| <~ 1e-6 for Phi ~ 1e-6.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Joint weak-lensing and dynamical mass measurements in low-Phi galaxies/clusters showing |eta - 1| >> 1e-3.

sealed_predictions.statement: Solar-system fifth-force amplitudes from S are exponentially amplitude-suppressed, remaining far below current bounds and PPN limits.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Improved ephemerides/spacecraft ranging (e.g., next-gen Cassini/Shapiro time-delay) detecting deviations inconsistent with exponential suppression.

sealed_predictions.statement: The RAR follows the Bose–Einstein form µ(g) = 1/(exp(\sqrt{g/a0}) - 1) with a single universal a0.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: A coherent, high-precision RAR dataset across galaxy types requiring a non–Bose–Einstein functional form or multiple a0 values.

sealed_predictions.statement: No extra tensor polarizations and no frequency-dependent modifications of the tensor kinetic operator.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Polarization-resolving GW detector networks or PTAs detecting extra polarizations/dispersion inconsistent with GR.

kill_criteria: KC1: A confirmed deviation of the gravitational-wave speed from c in vacuum at O(10–1000 Hz) above the ~1e-15 fractional level (GW–EM coincidences) would falsify the minimal-coupling class used by this EFC EFT.

KC2: Robust galaxy- or cluster-scale measurements showing |eta - 1| ≥ 1e-3 in low-potential (Phi ~ 1e-6) systems from joint lensing+kinematics would contradict the structural slip prediction eta = 1 + O(Phi*mu).
KC3: Detection of a solar-system fifth force or PPN parameter deviation (e.g., |gamma - 1| > 1e-5) incompatible with exponential amplitude suppression would rule out the proposed coupling structure.

KC4: High-precision RAR measurements demonstrating that the gravitational enhancement increases with acceleration over ≥2 decades in g (opposite the monotonic-decreasing Bose–Einstein form) would kill the EFT response postulate.
KC5: Observation of frequency-dependent GW dispersion or extra tensor polarizations inconsistent with GR would falsify the tensor-sector identity central to this framework.
abstract: We present the complete results of a systematic 17-iteration programme to construct and test a covariant scalar-tensor effective field theory (EFT) in which gravitational dynamics are modified by an entropy-like scalar field S via an acceleration-dependent response function. Five structural results hold independently of the specific mu(g): (i) c_gw = c exactly; (ii) gravitational slip eta ≈ 1 with O(Phi*mu) suppression; (iii) solar-system constraints satisfied by exponential amplitude suppression; (iv) ghost-free, tachyon-free, hyperbolic; (v) the RAR is formally identical to a Bose-Einstein occupation number. A critical negative result: the classical field equation produces a correction increasing with acceleration, whereas RAR requires a decreasing correction, identifying a microphysical gap.

action.formula: S = int d^4x sqrt(-g) [R/(16piG_N) + (1/2) g^{mu nu} d_mu S d_nu S - V(S) - beta |dS|_eps S^2 + L_m]

components.kinetic: (1/2) g^{mu nu} d_mu S d_nu S

departures_from_GR: One scalar field S with gradient-field coupling
No f(S)R coupling (minimal coupling to gravity)
No higher-curvature terms, no Riemann coupling

structural_results.title: Gravitational Wave Speed
structural_results.proof: For actions S = int sqrt(-g)[R/16piG + F(g,S,dS)] with no metric derivatives in F, the tensor kinetic operator is identical to GR. Delta_c/c ~ 10^-54, 10^39 times below GW170817 bound.
structural_results.comparison: Horndeski theories with G4(X)R modify tensor kinetic operator — EFC avoids this

structural_results.title: Gravitational Slip
structural_results.mechanism: Structural cancellation in radial stress T_rr: the '1' cancels with '-g_rr', leaving O(Phi) suppression
structural_results.note: Independent of specific mu form. Resolves x4800 time-delay problem from earlier EFC versions.

structural_results.title: Solar-System Compatibility
structural_results.note: Not chameleon/Vainshtein screening — functional amplitude suppression

structural_results.title: RAR as Bose-Einstein Statistics
structural_results.identification: Formally identical to Bose-Einstein occupation number <n> = 1/(exp(E/kT) - 1) with E/kT = sqrt(g/a0)
structural_results.interpretation: Spacetime grid has discrete nodes with bosonic excitation modes; E ~ sqrt(g), kT ~ sqrt(a0)
structural_results.uniqueness: Only acceleration coupling |nabla Phi| gives correct universal form (not density rho or potential Phi)

critical_gap.problem: Classical field equation from -beta|dS|S^2 produces T_00^(S) = beta S_0^2 kappa g / c^2, giving correction linear in g (increasing)
critical_gap.requirement: RAR requires mu(g) -> 0 as g -> infinity (decreasing)
critical_gap.diagnosis: BE form arises from quantum statistical mechanics, not classical field limit. Classical local Lagrangian generically produces polynomial corrections, not exponential suppression.
critical_gap.resolution_needed: Quantum treatment of S-field or fundamentally non-local coupling
critical_gap.what_survives: All structural results (SR1-SR5) are independent of specific mu form

eft_formulation.status: mu(g) postulated as effective relation, not derived from classical action

self_consistent_solution.with_potential: V(S) = (1/2) m_S^2 (S - S_0)^2, m_S ~ 10^-28 eV — tracking holds to ~0.1% from 1-100 kpc (v14)

construction_programme.methodology: Iterative falsification — each version tests a specific hypothesis
